# okfreq

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-001 — Provide requirements traceability operations](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-001.md) — The okfreq subset provides requirement traceability operations.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-002 — Author and validate requirements](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-002.md) — The okfreq layer creates, validates, and manages requirement documents and lifecycle.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-003 — Trace requirements to source and tests](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-003.md) — The okfreq layer records implementation and test markers and computes coverage.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-004 — Report requirement health](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-004.md) — The okfreq layer reports requirement hierarchy, coverage, and lifecycle health.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-005 — Validate requirement bundles](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-005.md) — When a requirement bundle is validated, okfreq SHALL check schemas, identities, hierarchy links, lifecycle values, and optional EARS prose while keeping prose findings advisory.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-006 — Merge requirement configuration safely](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-006.md) — When configuration is imported or merged, okfreq SHALL preserve existing conflicting values and unknown keys while reporting every conflict for review.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-007 — Manage requirement lifecycle explicitly](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-007.md) — When a confirmed archive or supersede operation is requested, okfreq SHALL apply the lifecycle transition without deleting the requirement and SHALL reject unconfirmed or unknown targets.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-008 — Ship usable standalone requirements guidance](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-008.md) — When requirements guidance is installed, the okfreq distribution SHALL provide self-contained operating instructions and executable examples of authoring, evidence, reports, navigation and recovery.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-009 — Maintain generated requirement navigation](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-009.md) — When requirement linting succeeds, okfreq SHALL refresh navigation indexes throughout the tiers tree while preserving authored text and change history.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-010 — Set up a project's requirements baseline from one skill](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-010.md) — When a user asks to set up okfreq in a project without a requirements bundle, the okfreq-setup skill SHALL direct the agent to deliver one pull request that specifies the project's current behaviour, anchored to its code and tests, without asking the user.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-011 — Retire a draft requirement permanently](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-011.md) — When a confirmed retire operation targets an unreferenced draft requirement, okfreq SHALL delete the requirement, record its ID as retired, and SHALL NOT allocate that number again.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-012 — Relate requirements by supersession and association](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-012.md) — When a requirement is superseded or related to others, okfreq SHALL record the replacing requirements in an authored superseded_by list, compute the inverse supersedes list, accept an authored relates_to list, and reject inconsistent or cyclic references.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-013 — Resolve requirement ownership and guard approvals](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-013.md) — When requirements are validated or regenerated, okfreq SHALL read tiers (or the legacy levels key) and the lifecycle field from configuration, take the accepted lifecycle values from the base schema, generate default_owner_email from the tier and scope owner settings, and reject an approved requirement whose tier and scope do not allow approval or that lacks approved_by and approved_at, with a message telling a coding agent to obtain and record the owner's agreement.
- [SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-014 — Keep requirement bundles native OKF bundles](SwRS-OKFSCHEMA-OKFREQ-014.md) — When requirements are created, changed, regenerated or validated, okfreq SHALL project the lifecycle onto OKF status, the owner approval onto a human verified event and the relation fields onto a generated Links section as declared by the bundle schemas, and SHALL run the base OKF checks on the tiers folder.
